contract: A23-91 server target hint: Swing / Release arg 1 = the client's pick (a monster Model). Valid only for a MANUAL attack and only when it is the Model of a monstersNear entry (alive, mine or nobody's, zone level gate, boss HitPad) within Range + HINT.Slack (2) and not hidden (rec._hidden / Model attribute Hidden). Valid: the root turns to it unless within HINT.KeepDeg (10 deg) of the facing; a turned attack hits monsters only (no player, no goose). Splash: centre = the pick. Multi: the pick first, then the nearest, no repeat. Around: the front half of the pick direction plus the pick itself even at Range + Slack (nobody else gets the slack). The queued manual swing keeps its pick; Q (ReleaseCenter Target) centres on the pick through SkillService (queued press too) or CombatService's fallback; a Self-centred Q ignores it. Anything else (wrong type, part, player character, dead / far / hidden / someone else's / gated monster, extra remote arguments, auto swings / auto Q) is ignored: the A23-61 swing of today.
limitations: The real client pick (HUD.PickTarget) and the network delay are not simulated (tools/test_auto_face.py covers the client). Splash keeps its blast radius around the pick, so a pick at Range + 2 reaches up to Range + 2 + Splash (as a pick inside Range always did). The IsA("Model") guard is redundant with the Model identity check and is not mutated. The CFrame turn is the combat world's double.
